Hi Mark — looping in the implementation and support leads to coordinate the tenant seed. Quick plan below and a couple of clarifying questions.

Plan (high level)
1) Create ClearWave "workspace" under your account ID and seed two initial projects: clearwave-dev (API keys for testing) and clearwave-prod (locked).
2) Provision one Admin user (samantha.lane@clearwavehealth.com) with Org Admin and Billing roles; invite via email.
3) Seed a single read-write API key into clearwave-dev for engineering experiments; keys live in the project vault and can be rotated.
4) Share onboarding checklist and role matrix (attached) for your records.

Questions
- Confirm SAMANTHA is the correct admin account to invite?
- Any IP allowlists we should add for production traffic?

Rishi — can you pick this up for a provisioning run this afternoon? Laura — please prepare the support access and SLA note for Mark's procurement.

Attachments: rw_onboarding_checklist_v1.xlsx, provisioning_role_matrix.csv

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Thanks — taking ownership. Action items I'm scheduling for today: 

- Create workspace: clearwave-health-2026 and seed projects clearwave-dev and clearwave-prod.
- Invite samantha.lane@clearwavehealth.com as Org Admin; she'll get an invite link that expires in 7 days.
- Generate one RW_DEV_API_KEY scoped to project clearwave-dev, description: "pilot key — ClearWave dev seeding".
- Populate the provisioning_role_matrix.csv with suggested roles for the initial 4 users Mark mentioned.

Notes/assumptions:
- Production project will remain disabled until procurement confirms PO and IP allowlist.
- Keys issued for dev are non-billable for first 14 days per trial policy; invoice behavior will follow after PO.

I will reply again with invite links and the seeded key metadata (key id only) once completed. If procurement needs a signed SOW or customer addendum, loop that document to contracts@redwood.ai.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference

We're preparing the standard onboarding package for ClearWave. A few items procurement can provide to unblock production:

- Signed PO or purchase intent email (we accept initial PO via procurement@clearwavehealth.com).
- IP ranges to add to the production allowlist (if any).
- Contact for billing verification (name + phone).

Support note: Your sandbox/dev will have 24/7 access to the hosted API and standard logging retention (7 days). If you require extended retention or SOC2 evidence, let us know and we'll route to our compliance team.

I'll attach the SLA summary to the HubSpot record; Kimberly / Rishi — please mark the workspace with the "procurement-pending" tag until we get a PO.
